semantics.hierarchy: Immediate child -> parent edges; not RP selectability or inferred categories.
semantics.exposure: Explicit stored flag, independent of hierarchy. Vocabulary filters only when roleplay_exposed=true is requested; not blanket search authorization.
semantics.priority: Direct per-tag override or default, no hierarchical priority inheritance; weighted coverage for preferred only; cannot compensate hard constraints.
semantics.counts: Canonical contents include materialized inherited tags. Paths are catalog entries, including stale/trash if present. No media records exported. Direct and inherited source counts may overlap and are not a partition; source provenance is not a new semantic edge.
semantics.safety: Safe/Suggestive/Explicit use exact content_rating; unknown if none. Not soft-score concepts. Safety exposure is locked.
semantics.request_filters: q, with, leaf_only, roleplay_exposed, scope, limit, offset are request parameters, not persisted RP profiles. leaf_only means no children, not RP exposure.
semantics.authority: No L1/L2/L3 policy/evidence export; canonical counts do not describe the complete hybrid retrieval pool.

unavailable: dedicated tag categories (hierarchy is exported instead)
